name: Design decision debate
description: Advocate and Skeptic cross-examine a design proposal claim by claim (specialists join when the brief needs them); the Synthesizer writes the decision record from the claims that stood, with numbered decisions.
whenToUse: A design, architecture or technology choice must be evaluated and decided, with its trade-offs recorded.

phases.title: Positions
phases.goal: The Advocate states the case for, the Skeptic the case against, the Synthesizer the decision criteria.

phases.title: Debate
phases.goal: Test every argument against the criteria until the decision is clear or the disagreement is stated precisely.

phases.title: Decide
phases.goal: Bring the user only the trade-offs that depend on business priorities.

phases.title: Decision record
phases.goal: Write the decision record and have both debaters confirm it represents their arguments fairly.

triggers: The options are tied on technical merit and differ on business priorities
Accepting a risk is a business decision
